qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Specialized RF plasma control impedance matching and microfocus X-ray inspection modules embedded in semiconductor fab equipment. While switching costs exist during a tool design cycle, extreme customer concentration (monopsonistic semicap OEMs like Lam Research and Applied Materials) strips Comet of structural pricing power, subjecting returns to severe downcycle margin compression.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC/pricing power, REJECT). Specialized supplier of RF plasma control modules and X-ray systems to semiconductor equipment OEMs. Severe customer concentration (Lam Research, AMAT) and intense semicap capex cyclicality strip Comet of independent pricing power, causing ROCE to collapse from 26% in 2021-2022 to 6.6% in 2023.
qualitative.evidence: Comet Holding AG supplies RF power delivery systems and X-ray inspection modules. Operating profitability is acutely exposed to the wafer fab equipment (WFE) capex cycle. Consolidated OEM buyers hold superior negotiating leverage. ROCE dropped sharply from 26.8% (2021) and 26.3% (2022) to 6.6% (2023) and 10.4% (2024), demonstrating sub-hurdle trough returns and absence of cycle-neutral pricing power.
